name: Syncthing Open Source File Sync
free_limit: MPL-2.0 open-source peer-to-peer file synchronization across your own computers; continuous encrypted transfers and local file storage, with no vendor-imposed per-device or transfer quota in the software.
watch_out: This is synchronization software, not free hosted object storage or backup. You provide devices, disks, network connectivity and maintenance; synchronization propagates deletions unless file versioning or separate backups are configured. MPL-2.0 source obligations apply to modifications and redistribution.
